value.rationale: The arithmetic plateau is a natural complete classification for two-site trapping: half-flux changes the nondecaying mode count by exactly +1 for certain even rings, by a negative amount for other even rings, and not at all for odd rings, while generic flux eliminates all modes. Each prediction gives a precise trap-placement/flux design boundary and remains exact for all positive absorption strengths. The zero-flux special cases are prior-covered; the half-flux switch, not a trivial normalization identity, motivates the classification.
